issues.legal_issue: A notification extending rent-control provisions to all municipalities applies to a municipality constituted after the notification without a fresh notification.
material_facts: The State Government issued a notification extending the relevant chapters of the Rent Control Order to all municipalities in the region.
The area containing the disputed premises became a municipality after that notification was issued.
The landlord brought an eviction suit concerning premises in that area without obtaining the Controller’s prior written permission.
The High Court held that a fresh notification was necessary, while the Supreme Court held that the existing notification applied and restored the dismissal of the suit.
issues.conclusion: The existing notification applied to the later-constituted municipality from the date it became a municipality; no fresh notification was required. Because the required prior permission had not been obtained, the eviction suit was not maintainable, and its dismissal was restored.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 2 of the Central Provinces and Berar Regulation of Letting of Accommodation Act, 1946, the notification extended Chapters II and IV of the Central Provinces and Berar Letting of Houses and Rent Control Order, 1949, to “all the Municipalities.” Those words include municipalities constituted after the notification, from the time they become municipalities. Clause 13 prohibits determining a lease without the Controller’s previous written permission. The Court relied on no earlier cases.

predicates.eviction_action_concerns_municipal_area: A landlord brought an eviction action concerning premises in the relevant area.
predicates.notification_covers_all_municipalities: The government issued a notification extending the relevant rent-control provisions to all municipalities in the region.
predicates.area_became_municipality_after_notificat: The area containing the premises became a municipality after the notification was issued.

issues.definition: When an eviction action concerns premises in an area covered by a general notification for all municipalities, and that area becomes a municipality later, the rent-control provisions apply there from the time it becomes a municipality.
